title: Implement priority room assignment with eviction
goal: Implement shop.rooms.assign exactly as specified in its docstring.
acceptance_criteria: bookings are processed by (start, -priority, id); a room is free at time s when its running booking ends at or before s (touching intervals do not conflict)
a booking takes the lowest-index free room

with no free room, the running booking with strictly lower priority than the new one is evicted: lowest priority first, then the latest end, then the highest room index; the new booking takes that room and the victim is appended to `rejected`; with no such victim the new booking is rejected
assign returns {'assignments': {booking_id: room_index}, 'rejected': [ids in order of rejection]}; evicted bookings are not in assignments
ValueError for rooms < 1, a booking with start >= end, or duplicate booking ids
